topic_seeds.topic: Functions, transformations, inverse relationships, and modelling
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Linked graphs, parameter controls, domain/range emphasis, and multiple representations tied to one state.

topic_seeds.topic: Limits, derivatives, local linearity, and rates of change
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Secant-to-tangent transitions, movable tangent, slope field, derivative comparison.

topic_seeds.topic: Integration and accumulation
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Signed area, moving bounds, Riemann sums, accumulation function, area-to-rate linkage.

topic_seeds.topic: Vectors, complex numbers, coordinates, and geometry
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Draggable vectors, projections, Argand plane, transformations, loci, and constrained constructions.

topic_seeds.topic: Probability, distributions, sampling, and inference
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Distribution morphs, sampling simulations, confidence/uncertainty bands, residual and regression views.

topic_seeds.topic: Mathematical mechanics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: State-linked trajectories, force/vector overlays, momentum and energy representations.

topic_seeds.topic: Kinematics and reference frames
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Position/velocity/acceleration linked to the same moving object and synchronized graphs.

topic_seeds.topic: Forces and dynamics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Free-body vectors attached to simulated bodies, resultant force, acceleration, friction, constraints.

topic_seeds.topic: Work, energy, momentum, and collisions
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Energy bars and phase plots linked to motion; collision before/after states with conserved quantities.

topic_seeds.topic: Rotation, torque, angular momentum, and gravitation
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Lever arms, angular vectors, rotational state, orbits and potential relationships.

topic_seeds.topic: Oscillations and waves
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Oscillator state, phase, propagation, superposition, standing waves, interference and resonance.

topic_seeds.topic: Fluids and thermal physics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Pressure/velocity fields, particle-to-bulk bridge, cycles, state diagrams, flow and buoyancy.

topic_seeds.topic: Electricity, magnetism, fields, and induction
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Field vectors/lines, equipotential surfaces, flux, charge motion, induction and circuit state.

topic_seeds.topic: Circuits and electronics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Validated circuit simulation with synchronized current, voltage, charge and component state.

topic_seeds.topic: Atomic structure, spectra, orbitals, and periodicity
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Energy levels, spectra, orbital geometry, periodic trends and electron configuration linked across representations.

topic_seeds.topic: Bonding, molecular shape, intermolecular forces, and structure
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Chemically correct 2D structure plus rotatable 3D geometry, orbital overlap, polarity and packing.

topic_seeds.topic: States, gases, solutions, and particle models
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Micro-to-macro particle behavior linked to pressure, concentration, phase and measurable properties.

topic_seeds.topic: Energetics and thermodynamics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Reaction coordinate, energy cycles, state functions, entropy/free-energy comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Kinetics and mechanisms
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Collision/energy distributions, rate graphs, reaction coordinate, elementary steps and causal electron movement.

topic_seeds.topic: Equilibrium, acids, bases, and solubility
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Dynamic opposing processes, composition vs condition, titration/speciation curves and equilibrium shifts.

topic_seeds.topic: Redox and electrochemistry
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Electron/ion flow, electrode processes, cell potential, concentration effects and electrolysis state.

topic_seeds.topic: Organic reactions and synthesis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Atom identity preserved through mechanisms, electron-pushing, bond morphing, stereochemical and pathway views.

topic_seeds.topic: Spectroscopy and analytical chemistry
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Spectrum-to-structure linkage, peak annotation, fragmentation and evidence comparison.

topic_seeds.topic: Biomolecules and molecular interactions
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Protein/nucleic-acid structure, binding sites, molecular recognition and structure-function relationships.

topic_seeds.topic: Cells, membranes, transport, and organelles
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Layered anatomy, selective transport, gradients, compartment relationships and scale transitions.

topic_seeds.topic: Enzymes, respiration, and photosynthesis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Reaction/state networks, energy transfer, limiting factors and linked molecular-to-system views.

topic_seeds.topic: DNA, gene expression, inheritance, and biotechnology
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Sequence-to-process views, chromosome/gene structure, probability and pedigree/inheritance models.

topic_seeds.topic: Signalling, immunity, coordination, and homeostasis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Feedback loops, receptor pathways, system anatomy and changing internal state.

topic_seeds.topic: Evolution and population genetics
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Allele-frequency change, selection/drift simulations, phylogenetic relationships and variation distributions.

topic_seeds.topic: Ecology, populations, communities, and cycles
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Food/network graphs, abundance distributions, sampling uncertainty, nutrient flows and population dynamics.

topic_seeds.topic: Atmosphere, weather, climate, ocean circulation, and coupled Earth systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Vector/flow fields, layers, circulation cells, time series, anomaly maps and coupled-system diagrams.

topic_seeds.topic: Biogeochemical, water, carbon, and nutrient cycles
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Stock-flow systems tied to geography and time rather than decorative circular arrows.

topic_seeds.topic: Ecosystems, productivity, biodiversity, and fisheries
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Food/network relationships, spatial distributions, population dynamics, trophic transfer and uncertainty.

topic_seeds.topic: Earth processes, hazards, coasts, and marine systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Terrain/cross-sections, hazard propagation, plate/process animation, bathymetry and shoreline change.

topic_seeds.topic: Pollution, resource use, energy, and sustainability
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Source-pathway-receptor flows, spatial exposure, scenarios, trade-offs and impact comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Hydrology, rivers, water resources, and hazards
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Catchment maps, longitudinal/cross profiles, hydrographs, flow networks, flood extent and management scenarios.

topic_seeds.topic: Atmosphere, climate, and climate change
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Global/local maps, pressure/wind fields, climate graphs, anomalies and time-linked spatial change.

topic_seeds.topic: Earth processes, mass movement, and environments
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Cross-sections, terrain, process sequences, risk layers and spatial comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Population, migration, and demographic change
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Choropleths/dot maps, flow maps, age structures, migration networks and time-series transitions.

topic_seeds.topic: Urban areas, land use, infrastructure, and management
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Layered city maps, accessibility, land-use patterns, network flows and scenario comparison.

topic_seeds.topic: Global environments and themes
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Multi-scale maps and linked evidence panels preserving case-study location, time and uncertainty.

topic_seeds.topic: Data representation, encoding, compression, and information
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Bit/byte layouts, transforms, encoding pipelines, compression state and error representations.

topic_seeds.topic: Logic, processors, computer architecture, and operating systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Data-path diagrams, register/memory state, fetch-decode-execute, scheduling and layered system anatomy.

topic_seeds.topic: Algorithms and data structures
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Step-through execution with stable item identity, complexity plots, tree/graph state and invariant highlighting.

topic_seeds.topic: Programming, objects, recursion, and memory
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Source line linked to call stack, heap/object graph, variable state and control flow.

topic_seeds.topic: Networks and distributed communication
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Packet routes, protocol layers, latency/throughput, topology and failure propagation.

topic_seeds.topic: Databases and information systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Entity relationships, tables/keys, query transformation, indexing and transaction state.

topic_seeds.topic: AI, robotics, and computational models
topic_seeds.visualize_as: State/action loops, search trees, model inputs/outputs and sensor-to-actuator pipelines without anthropomorphic decoration.

topic_seeds.topic: Cybersecurity
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Trust boundaries, attack paths, protocol/state diagrams, threat surfaces and defense-in-depth layers.

topic_seeds.topic: Scarcity, production possibilities, opportunity cost, and trade-offs
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Feasible frontiers, marginal trade-offs, constrained choice and scenario shifts.

topic_seeds.topic: Demand, supply, elasticity, intervention, and welfare
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Interactive curves, equilibrium shifts, incidence, surplus/deadweight areas and parameter sensitivity.

topic_seeds.topic: Firms, costs, revenue, market structure, and competition
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Linked cost/revenue curves, scale, profit regions, game/market structure comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Macroeconomic flows and indicators
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Stock-flow/circular-flow views, inflation/unemployment/output time series and decomposition.

topic_seeds.topic: Aggregate demand/supply, money, policy, and growth
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Linked macro models, policy scenarios, transmission pathways and uncertainty around outcomes.

topic_seeds.topic: International trade, exchange rates, development, and global issues
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Trade/network flows, comparative advantage, FX graphs, development distributions and country comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Accounting, finance, budgeting, and personal finance
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Statement flows, cash/working-capital timelines, break-even, compounding, loan/investment scenarios and risk-return.

topic_seeds.topic: Marketing, operations, management, and strategy
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Process flows, capacity/bottlenecks, segmentation maps, portfolio/trade-off matrices and causal assumptions.

topic_seeds.topic: Biological, cognitive, learning, and social approaches
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Competing models, process diagrams, study designs and evidence alignment rather than literal brain cartoons.

topic_seeds.topic: Research methods, data, reliability, validity, and inference
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Experimental design, sampling, distributions, uncertainty, correlation and evidence-quality comparison.

topic_seeds.topic: Clinical, health, consumer, and organisational psychology
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Pathways, study comparisons, interventions, outcomes and context-sensitive causal models.

topic_seeds.topic: Social structures, institutions, inequality, identity, and change
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Networks, distributions, cohort/time comparisons and multi-level relationships with source context retained.

topic_seeds.topic: Chronology and periodisation
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Multi-track timelines that distinguish event date, duration, region and thematic strand.

topic_seeds.topic: War, migration, expansion, trade, and exchange
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Time-aware maps and flow networks with uncertainty/provenance rather than decorative arrows.

topic_seeds.topic: Causes, consequences, continuity, and change
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Evidence-linked causal graphs or matrices that preserve competing interpretations.

topic_seeds.topic: Institutions, constitutions, elections, states, and political systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Institutional relationships, process/state diagrams, jurisdiction maps and comparative structures.

topic_seeds.topic: Primary and secondary source analysis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Aligned source/evidence panels showing provenance, claim, corroboration, contradiction and missing evidence.

topic_seeds.topic: Composition, form, colour, texture, typography, and visual hierarchy
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Layer isolation, crop/alignment comparison, compositional overlays and controllable transformations.

topic_seeds.topic: Materials, fabrication, product structure, and design technology
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Exploded assemblies, material layers, manufacturing sequences, tolerances and annotated 3D structure.

topic_seeds.topic: Perspective, space, light, staging, movement, and performance
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Camera/light controls, blocking, stage plans, viewpoint comparison and time-based scene development.

topic_seeds.topic: Media language, editing, sequence, and representation
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Shot/timeline structure, composition comparison, edit rhythm, information layers and evidence-backed annotation.

topic_seeds.topic: Design process, iteration, critique, and contextual research
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Version/decision trails, alternatives, constraints, references and evidence rather than a generic double-diamond diagram.

topic_seeds.topic: Pitch, scales, keys, intervals, and tuning relationships
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Staff/keyboard/pitch-class views synchronized with sound and interval geometry.

topic_seeds.topic: Rhythm, meter, tempo, syncopation, and polyrhythm
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Beat grid, onset timeline, meter hierarchy and playback cursor.

topic_seeds.topic: Harmony, chords, function, cadence, and voice leading
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Score-linked harmonic function, voice trajectories, chord graph and playable before/after comparisons.

topic_seeds.topic: Melody, motive, sequence, texture, orchestration, and timbre
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Contour, motif correspondence, layered parts, orchestration layers and audio-aligned annotations.

topic_seeds.topic: Form, phrase, set works, performance, and composition
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Time-aligned formal sections, score/audio navigation, comparative interpretations and version layers.

topic_seeds.topic: Grammar, syntax, morphology, and sentence structure
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Dependency/constituency relationships, transformations and aligned examples only when structure is the learning target.

topic_seeds.topic: Phonology, pronunciation, prosody, and listening
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Stress/intonation contours, timing and phonetic contrasts synchronized with audio when warranted.

topic_seeds.topic: Vocabulary, semantics, register, and discourse relationships
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Semantic networks, collocation patterns, register continua and corpus distributions with examples attached.

topic_seeds.topic: Narrative, argument, rhetoric, and textual structure
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Argument/evidence maps, narrative time, motif recurrence and paragraph/claim structure as optional analytic lenses.

topic_seeds.topic: Literary comparison and historical/cultural context
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Evidence-aligned comparison, chronology and context maps; close reading remains primary.

topic_seeds.topic: Legal rules, doctrines, tests, procedure, and precedent
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Decision trees, process/state diagrams, precedent networks and rule-to-fact application while preserving exceptions.

topic_seeds.topic: Arguments, assumptions, evidence, counterclaims, and reasoning
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Argument maps that distinguish premise, inference, evidence, objection and uncertainty.

topic_seeds.topic: Religious, philosophical, and classical texts or traditions
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Chronology, textual relationships, schools/traditions and historical context; interpretation itself should not be reduced to a graph.

topic_seeds.topic: Biomechanics and movement analysis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Joint/segment kinematics, force vectors, centre of mass, projectile motion and technique comparison.

topic_seeds.topic: Anatomy, physiology, and body systems
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Layered anatomy, circulation/respiration pathways and physiological response over exercise intensity/time.

topic_seeds.topic: Energy systems, training, fatigue, and recovery
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Contribution over intensity/time, training-load curves, adaptation timelines and performance data.

topic_seeds.topic: Skill acquisition, tactics, and performance analysis
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Movement trajectories, spatial occupancy, decision networks and annotated video-derived events when data is available.

topic_seeds.topic: Research question, claims, evidence, sources, and perspectives
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Evidence maps, provenance, claim-source matrices and competing-perspective relationships.

topic_seeds.topic: Methods, variables, sampling, data, and limitations
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Study design, data pipeline, distribution/uncertainty and limitation annotations.

topic_seeds.topic: Synthesis, argument development, and communication
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Argument structure and evidence coverage as planning/debugging aids rather than replacements for writing.

topic_seeds.topic: Destinations, accessibility, visitor flows, and transport
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Real maps, origin-destination flows, travel-time/accessibility and seasonality.

topic_seeds.topic: Tourism systems, stakeholders, products, and operations
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Stakeholder/network relationships, service process, capacity and dependency diagrams.

topic_seeds.topic: Demand, impacts, sustainability, and destination management
topic_seeds.visualize_as: Time series, distributions, spatial pressure, trade-offs and scenario comparisons tied to real cases.
